meta.name: seo-drift
meta.description: SEO drift monitoring: capture baselines of SEO-critical elements, detect changes, and track regressions over time. Git for SEO — baseline, diff, and track changes to your on-page SEO. Use when user says "SEO drift", "baseline", "track changes", "did anything break", "SEO regression", "compare SEO", "before and after", "monitor SEO changes", or "deployment check".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪网页SEO元素的变化与回归
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次部署后都要手动检查SEO是否被破坏
copy.tagline_en: Track changes and regressions in on-page SEO elements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to catch SEO regressions after every deployment

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以捕获网页的 SEO 关键元素（如标题、描述、H1等）作为基线，并与当前状态对比，检测变化和回归。
howto.when: 当你提到“SEO drift”、“baseline”、“track changes”、“compare SEO”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 https://example.com 建立 SEO 基线。
say.note: Claude 会捕获当前页面状态并存储。

say.text: 对比 https://example.com 的当前状态与基线。
say.note: Claude 会运行17条规则，输出差异报告。

say.text: 查看 https://example.com 的 SEO 变更历史。
say.note: Claude 会显示所有基线及对比摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can capture SEO-critical elements (title, description, H1, etc.) of a webpage as a baseline, then compare the current state to detect changes and regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "SEO drift", "baseline", "track changes", "compare SEO", etc.

say_en.text: Create an SEO baseline for https://example.com.
say_en.note: Claude captures and stores the current page state.

say_en.text: Compare https://example.com current state to its baseline.
say_en.note: Claude runs 17 rules and outputs a diff report.

say_en.text: Show the SEO change history for https://example.com.
say_en.note: Claude displays all baselines and comparison summaries.
